verdict.rationale: Warp ships multiple official CLIs for AI-native workflows: the Warp Agent CLI (standalone, works in any terminal/IDE, supports remote sessions and interactive apps) and the Oz CLI for running/managing cloud agents from any terminal, script, or CI pipeline, with MCP integration. This is documented in first-party docs and confirmed by a live probe of the CLI reference page. Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on validation specifically of the CLI tools (community evidence in the pack focuses on the desktop app, not the CLI).
